pr.title: Resurrect trim@0.0.1: replace with String.prototype.trim / trimStart / trimEnd
pr.body:
## 🪦 trim@0.0.1 → Replace route

**Why this package:** risk 86/100, status **deprecated**.
- Deprecated by its author
- Source repository is archived
- No release for 5.6 years
- 1 known advisory
- Imported at 2 sites in 2 files
- Author's deprecation notice: "Use String.prototype.trim() instead"
- Advisory [GHSA-w5p7-h5w8-2hfq](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2020-7753) (high): Regular Expression Denial of Service in trim

**Coroner's verdict:** A maintained replacement exists: String.prototype.trim / trimStart / trimEnd. Replace trim (ReDoS advisory CVE-2020-7753 in 0.0.1) with the built-in string methods. 1 candidate will be proven against the original before any change is kept.

### What changed
- Added `graveyard/shims/trim.cjs`: String.prototype.trim, trimStart and trimEnd
- Rewrote 2 imports in 2 files: `src/cart.js`, `src/format.js`
- Removed `trim` from package.json and package-lock.json
- The public API of this project is unchanged: callers keep the same function names and arguments.

### Proof
fast-check generated inputs and ran each one through **both** the original `trim@0.0.1` and the new code. Every output had to be deep-equal (or both had to throw the same error type).

| Property | Runs | Result |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| trim() strips the same whitespace | 500 | ✅ agree |
| trim.left() matches | 500 | ✅ agree |
| trim.right() matches | 500 | ✅ agree |
| non-string input fails the same way | 500 | ✅ agree |
| no ReDoS: 20,000 spaces either side of a word (old 644.8 ms, new 0.08 ms, limit 25 ms) | 1 | ✅ agree |

2001 generated inputs, seed `20261031`, 712 ms. Ran in a Node.js permission-model sandbox: read-only file access, no child processes, empty environment.

### Replay test (stays in the repo)
160 recorded cases in `graveyard/proofs/trim.golden.json`, replayed by `graveyard/proofs/trim.proof.test.js` with `node --test`: ✅ pass. They keep guarding the behaviour after the original package is gone.

Project tests (`npm test`): ✅ pass

### Risk note
- Equivalence is proven on generated inputs within the documented API, not on every possible value. Replace trim (ReDoS advisory CVE-2020-7753 in 0.0.1) with the built-in string methods.
- Built-in trimming runs in linear time, which removes the ReDoS in trim < 0.0.3.

### Provenance
- Original: `trim@0.0.1` (installed copy, matching the lockfile version)
- Integrity: `sha512-YzQV+TZg4AxpKxaTHK3c3D+kRDCGVEE7L…`
- Licence: MIT (no original code is copied)
- Recipe: `trim-native`, candidate `native-trim`

### Reviewer checklist
- [ ] The rewritten imports are the only call sites
- [ ] The risk note matches how this project uses the package
- [ ] CI passes

_Opened by Graveyard Shift. The Coroner chose the route, the Surgeon made the change, the proof decided. A human reviews and merges; nothing is published automatically. After merge, a Warden keeper bot watches this package for new advisories._
